narr: Strong thunderstorms resulted in Flash Flooding around the Matagorda Bay area. Isolated locations received up to 8-10 inches of rainfall.
ev: Local emergency managers reported floodwater covering TX-111 east of FM 1157.
Local emergency managers reported water covering roads across Louise.
FM 1157 was impassable due to floodwaters between CR-208 and CR-215. The road was closed.
FM 111 was impassable due to floodwaters between TX-172 and TX-71. The road was closed.
